reviews.title: Metronome Audio No longer works
reviews.text: My blind mom used and paid for the ad free version of this app a number of years ago, and is disappointed that the audio tones from the metronome feature no longer exists in the app. As someone who’s blind, she needs the audio function in order to use the metronome function at all, and this was one of the only apps that met the requirement. However, in the newer version, this feature is missing. I would appreciate that this feature was brought back so my mom could use it again.
